# routeros_routing_pimsm_bsr_candidate (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_routing_pimsm_bsr_candidate" "candidate" {
  instance = "example"
  address  = "192.0.2.1"
  disabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance` (String) Name of the PIM-SM instance this bootstrap router candidate belongs to.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `address` (String) The address advertised as the address of this bootstrap router candidate. The console also offers the interface names here, in which case the address of that interface is used.
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `hashmask_length` (Number) The length of the hash mask advertised in the bootstrap messages. It controls over how many consecutive groups a single rendezvous point is used.
- `priority` (Number) The bootstrap router election priority. The candidate with the highest priority wins the election.
- `scope4` (String) The IPv4 administrative scope this candidate is a bootstrap router for. The console exposes no value domain for this property and it is not covered by the MikroTik documentation - supply the raw RouterOS value.
- `scope6` (String) The IPv6 administrative scope this candidate is a bootstrap router for. The console exposes no value domain for this property and it is not covered by the MikroTik documentation - supply the raw RouterOS value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `inactive` (Boolean)
- `state` (String) The current state of the bootstrap router election for this candidate.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/routing/pimsm/bsr/candidate get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_routing_pimsm_bsr_candidate.candidate "*1"
```
